$comment: Separation of duties for agents. Start Claude with `make design`, `make build` or `make factory` (sets DSF_MODE). The PreToolUse hooks refuse edits to the paths a mode protects.

design.description: Interviews, vision, PRD, user acceptance scenarios, architecture, modules and ADRs. No production code.

build.description: Implement tasks: production code, unit, component and integration tests, UAT step definitions.

factory.description: Improve the factory itself: skills, hooks, rules, checks, CI, docs.
